dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: Why — you planning on helping me do it? Whatever it is?

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: In that case, I need to give this some thought. I wanna find out exactly where that line is... and then see how far you can be persuaded to bend it...

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: Although the expression on your face was priceless, I'm not in the business to make you suffer just for my amusement.

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: If you really have nothing better to do, why don't you go find something for me to eat?

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: It's not strictly necessary. Not for me, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: But I've always found dinner tables to be extremely fascinating.

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: Everyone's got their own agenda, but they all have to pretend to be cordial and considerate.

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: Ah... what I wouldn't give to take you to one of the Harbingers' banquets.

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: Hah, the extreme lengths they'll go to to get out of the missions they dislike...

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: Hehe, it's truly a pity that only the two of us are here. A party of two won't have any good drama.

dialogues.speaker: Wanderer
dialogues.text: Anyway, I'm not picky, so I'll eat whatever you make.

choices.text: Still, give me something to work with.

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: Why don't you make some of your personal favorites?

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: So even if it gets painfully awkward during our meal, we can still at least enjoy the food.

choices.text: Got it. I'll go prepare a whole feast of desserts!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Eh? Why are you apologizing all of a sudden?

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: I was just conceding an error in my judgment.

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: Anyway, it's probably a good thing that you have a mean streak.

response.speaker: Wanderer
response.text: I don't think I could stand to be around you if you were completely incorruptible.
